explication: WPF UI is a Fluent-style control and appearance library for WPF applications. The principal workflow is that an application loads the library’s resources, builds its interface from its controls, and applies a theme; navigation and dialog services support richer interaction. Separate runtime capabilities include tray icons, syntax highlighting, and toast notifications. The tree and README establish these product areas, while sampled excerpts confirm selected theme, navigation registration, and tray internals; links between unsampled subsystems are therefore kept minimal.
